neighbours.label: scalar and focus adverbs that set up an expectation (even / Chinese 甚至, 'not only', hardly, 'as if') and the Chinese modal 会
fire: 这种材料很轻，有些工厂甚至用它来做飞机零件。
如果温度太高，这层涂料会很快脱落。
他工作非常努力，周末甚至也不休息。
医生说这种药会影响病人的睡眠。
She stared at the letter as if it had been written to someone else.
The new alloy not only resists rust but also costs less to make.
The price of rice has hardly moved since the harvest.
The old pump will definitely fail before the winter.

The price of rice has moved a great deal since the harvest.
The old pump was replaced before the winter.
